expectations.text: Uses resource() to fetch dropdown options based on category signal
expectations.evidence: smart-dropdown.component.ts:87-91 uses `resource({ params: () => ({ categoryId: this.categoryId() }), loader: ... })` — correct params-based reactive pattern

expectations.text: Uses linkedSignal with object syntax (source + computation + previous) to preserve valid selection
expectations.evidence: smart-dropdown.component.ts:117-135 uses `linkedSignal<DropdownOption[], DropdownOption | undefined>({ source: this.options, computation: (newOptions, previous) => { ... } })` — finds previous selection in new list

expectations.text: Uses computed() for derived display string
Uses custom equality function ({equal: fn}) on at least one signal
expectations.evidence: smart-dropdown.component.ts:99-105 uses `computed(..., { equal: (a, b) => a.length === b.length && a.every((opt, i) => opt.id === b[i].id) })` — deep equality by option IDs

expectations.text: Does NOT use effect() to sync selection state
expectations.evidence: No effect() calls anywhere. Selection sync handled by linkedSignal computation.
